chapters.description: I took the bet that agents need more than help building a product in a silo — they need a harness that builds the business around it. I led the 5-week push from first commit to Play Store beta and I run the build cadence that keeps it shipping.
chapters.quest: I decided to own distribution end-to-end

chapters.description: Two business moves: I unblocked enterprise revenue by shipping AI inside PowerPoint, and I raised a $20k angel check by turning 10,000 patents into a market story. Then I left to own destiny full-time.
chapters.quest: I learned to ship inside constraints

chapters.description: The business needed a machine that lands material on target. I designed and built it, killed the vibration that was missing, and wrote the control software that runs it. Closed the loop to 10µm.
chapters.quest: I owned precision, not just code

chapters.description: When the instrument I needed didn't exist, I built it — potentiostat, firmware, fabrication process. That habit never left. 5 papers, 29 citations, h-index 3.
